Du loggar in och skriver under hos :prov: You sign in and sign at :provider. How the service processes your data is in the service's terms and privacy policy; ask :company if you want to know more. NONOX sends only a checksum computed from the document there, never the document itself. Your certificate is put into the signed PDF, which every signer and copy recipient gets. The certificate holds the data the service has put in it, often your name and your personal identity number. NONOX keeps the certificate's name, issuer, serial number and validity as evidence, but not the personal identity number outside the PDF.
